summary.text: Sebastian Ellefson is the Democratic candidate for the Minnesota House of Representatives, District 65B, in the November 3, 2026 general election; he advanced from the August 11 Democratic primary.
He is an attorney who, in a Ballotpedia survey, described himself as a legal aid attorney and a co-founder of BallotReady.

paragraphs.text: Sebastian Ellefson earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Chicago, a graduate degree from Loyola University Chicago and a law degree from the University of Minnesota Law School.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he was born and raised in the Twin Cities, lives on St. Paul's West Side, and has been a volunteer and board member of the West Side Community Organization.
Ellefson said in the survey that his key campaign messages are renters' rights, funding for programs that support small businesses, and protecting Minnesotans against federal immigration raids.
He also listed police reform, including mental health crisis responders on 911 calls, among the policy areas he is passionate about.
